title: Novaryn Announcer
description: A lightweight and highly configurable announcement plugin with chat, action bar, title, boss bar, sound, PlaceholderAPI, hex color, and clickable message support.
body:
#  📢 Novaryn Announcer


[![wiki](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7e62c2841328c6a398c20d6fd5cf781bc657bfbf.webp)](https://wiki.nyctohost.com/)  [![discord](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c6aec3fdefb233136d2eed74b726e78a70d1ca67.webp)](https://discord.gg/vapBzZfWcp)

**Novaryn Announcer** is a modern, lightweight, and highly configurable announcement plugin built for **Paper, Purpur, Spigot, and Bukkit** servers.

Create beautiful rotating announcements using **Chat**, **Action Bars**, **Titles**, **Boss Bars**, and **Sounds**. Whether you want to promote your Discord, remind players to vote, advertise your store, or display server tips, Novaryn Announcer gives you full control over how, when, and where announcements appear.

With support for **PlaceholderAPI**, **hex colors**, **clickable messages**, **hover text**, **per-player toggles**, and advanced targeting options, it is designed to fit both small survival servers and large Minecraft networks.

---

![FEATURE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b04802a80d65fdf8ddcf65fcc6c96853c0861f3d.png)

* 🔄 **Multiple rotation modes**
  Ordered, random, and weighted-random announcement rotations.

* 💬 **Multiple announcement types**
  Send announcements through chat, action bars, titles, boss bars, and sounds.

* 🖱️ **Clickable & hoverable chat messages**
  Add clickable links, commands, and hover text to your announcements.

* 🎨 **Modern color support**
  Supports legacy colors and hex colors using `&#RRGGBB`.

* 🔌 **PlaceholderAPI support**
  Display player names, ranks, server stats, and more inside announcements.

* 🎯 **Advanced targeting filters**
  Control announcements by permission, world, cooldown, online player limits, and time windows.

* 👤 **Per-player announcement toggle**
  Let players enable or disable announcements for themselves.

* 🚪 **Join announcements**
  Send special announcements when players join the server.

* 🔧 **Automatic config updates**
  Keeps your configuration updated with safe backups.

* ⚡ **Lightweight & optimized**
  Built to run smoothly without unnecessary performance impact.

---

## 📦 Compatibility

| Requirement             | Version                       |
| ----------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| **Minecraft**           | 1.21 – 1.21.11+               |
| **Java**                | 21+                           |
| **Platforms**           | Paper, Purpur, Spigot, Bukkit |
| **Optional Dependency** | PlaceholderAPI                |

---

## 🔑 Commands

```text
/novarynannouncer help
/novarynannouncer reload
/novarynannouncer list
/novarynannouncer preview
/novarynannouncer send
/novarynannouncer next
/novarynannouncer toggle
/novarynannouncer status
```

### Command Aliases

```text
/nannounce
/announcer
/announcements
```

---

## ❤️ Perfect For

* Server store advertisements
* Discord server promotion
* Voting reminders
* Rules and useful tips
* Network-wide announcements
* Seasonal events
* Rank sale messages
* Update notices
* Community reminders

---

## 🚀 Why Use Novaryn Announcer?

Novaryn Announcer is built for server owners who want a simple but powerful announcement system. It keeps the setup clean while still giving you advanced control over message styling, targeting, timing, and player interaction.

Whether you run a small community server or a full Minecraft network, Novaryn Announcer helps you deliver clean, professional, and eye-catching announcements with ease.
